question: Review and harden stretch-insensitive autocal: robust bootstrap, home compensation, HP3/HP4 regression battery and broader machine support

agents.question: Determine and implement physically justified final home-shift compensation for stretch-insensitive autocal, using existing RRF/Klipper flex models; quantify evidence and limitations.
Build and exercise reproducible full HP3/HP4 autocal sanity battery including varied stiffness/noise and HP4 worn bearings, plus lightweight recorded-data solver comparisons and regressions.
Review production integration of pose fit, information planning and equal-strain forces; pilot or plan four_high_anchors and cube_corners support; identify concrete correctness defects.

Independently review the combined autocal hardening candidate for bootstrap, profile selection, offset propagation, ablation correctness and guarded home compensation; reproduce decisive checks and identify regressions.
Evaluate the hardened candidate on full HP3/HP4 compliance and bearing variants, and paired same-data fitter/offset/filtering ablations including deterministic noise stress.
Review fixes to bootstrap restart refusal, measurement-model purity and historical projection handling, and the independent joint range benchmark against the prior review findings.

Test one bounded terminal-validation sweep that compares frozen final autocal candidates on common fresh data, without refitting the held-out sweep; determine whether it reduces observed final-selection regret.
Independently review the default-off terminal validation pilot for frozen common data, stopping and failure semantics, and offline replay correctness.
